newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES- Taiwan governor James Soong insists he is resigning despite long talk with Premier Lien Chan.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Governor Soong insists on quitting after late-night meeting with Premier Lien.
Air force plans to hand S-2T anti-submarine fighters to navy in three years.
LIBERTY TIMES - Governor Soong still wants to quit after meeting Premier Lien.
Hsu Hsin-liang, chairman of Democratic Progressive Party, says party will expel those who do not follow agreement reached at all-party conference in December.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan will soon allow Taiwan dollar option trading.
Heavy rain, snowstorms cause disasters in America, Europe.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan may allow Taiwan dollar option trading in June.
